node_definition.done_when: A test in tests/test_a_reduced_brief_leaves_a_trace.py refuses one dispatch on context fit and accepts a shortened dispatch of the same node id, then requires the accepted run to carry the fact of the reduction and what changed (the refused and accepted estimates and the paths or text removed); promotes that run in a fixture and requires the ledger row to carry the same record; and requires a node accepted on its first attempt to carry no such marker. Refusals are recorded under the crew home, never in the repository. The new cases fail at the base. The negative control is executed and logged. Gate: tests/test_a_reduced_brief_leaves_a_trace.py tests/test_dispatch_context_estimate_is_one_figure.py tests/test_crew_promotion.py tests/test_ledger.py. baseline_suite and after_suite are run with the project's armed suite command, PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_a_reduced_brief_leaves_a_trace.py, at the base and at the head, each log naming its revision, tree and literal command and ending EXIT=. Every test file that imports a production module the node changed adds no failure against a base arm: run both arms from git archive extractions on node-local disk with the main checkout's .env linked, record both logs, and re-run any id that differs between arms serially three times on each revision. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Run the gate in the foreground on the fleet allocation.
node_definition.goal: Record on a run accepted after a context refusal of the same node id that it was retried and what changed in its brief, and carry that record onto its promoted ledger row
node_definition.negative_control: skip recording the refusal; the accepted run carries no reduction marker and the test fails
